entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv5770"/><div sID="gen8784" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv5770"/>9. Terror-stricken animals and denuded forests close the illustration. In view of this scene of awful sublimity, God's worshippers respond to the call of <reference osisRef="Ps.29.2">Psa 29:2</reference>, and speak or cry, "Glory!" By "temple," or "palace" (God's residence, <reference osisRef="Ps.5.7">Psa 5:7</reference>), may here be meant heaven, or the whole frame of nature, as the angels are called on for praise. <div eID="gen8784" type="x-p"/>
